title: Nilo Rodis-Jamero
description: Nilo Rodis-Jamero had a father who wanted him to become a priest. But the  artist went to school in California, started designing vehicles for General Motors, and was lured away to join the art department at ILM. Here are his sketches for the Emperor (front) and the Irnperial Royal Guards (back) based on designs by him and Aggie Guerard Rodgers.
